_why: Settings for the lean PR reviewer (KIPI_REVIEW_LEAN=1, ASK-4743). The reviewer runs with --setting-sources '' so NO user, project or plugin settings load, which drops every context-injecting hook. A reviewer that can run Bash must still sit behind the machine-protecting gates, so exactly these hooks are re-attached and nothing else. The project permission model (its Bash allow list and its deny list for sudo, chmod 777, curl-pipe-bash, .env and key reads) is ALSO dropped and NOT re-attached: lean mode runs on a blanket Read,Grep,Glob,Bash allow, bounded by the guards below and the disallowed git clone, gh and curl. The hooks are: destructive-op deny (rm -rf, force push, reset --hard), the archived-engagement deny, and the .claude write guard. KIPI_REVIEW_SCRIPTS is exported by pr-review-agent.sh and points at the trusted control checkout, never at the PR tree under review.
